data.name: Mazkoorah
data.gender_notes: Mazkoorah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Mazkoorah is derived from the Arabic word 'Mazkurah' which means 'a blooming plant, a flower in full bloom'. This name is often given to babies born during the spring season or to those who are believed to bring happiness and joy to their families. The name Mazkoorah carries the meaning “Blossom, bloom, flower” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mazkoorah usually hope their child will grow to embody blossom, bloom, flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Mazkoorah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Blossom, bloom, flower.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mazkoorah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
